network.note: Rime has no India region. This is the geographic floor, not model time.

ttfb_warm_ms.note: flush on an already-open socket — the product's path

model_ms_note: warm TTFB minus one TCP RTT. An estimate of the non-network component, reported separately so geography is not sold as model speed. Rime's published 96 ms P50 is a self-hosted H100 number.

bargein_stop_ms.method: send clear, then CLOSE the socket. `clear` does not cancel in-flight synthesis and contextId is not a fence, so closing is the only hard stop.
